instruction:

### Question:
How many singers do we have?

### Schema:
<schema>
CREATE TABLE stadium (  Stadium_ID INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Location TEXT, Example: ['Raith Rovers', 'Ayr United']<|endoftext|>
  Name TEXT, Example: ["Stark's Park", 'Somerset Park']<|endoftext|>
  Capacity INTEGER, Example: [10104, 11998]<|endoftext|>
  Highest INTEGER, Example: [4812, 2363]<|endoftext|>
  Lowest INTEGER, Example: [1294, 1057]<|endoftext|>
  Average INTEGER, Example: [2106, 1477]<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (Stadium_ID)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE singer (  Singer_ID INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Name TEXT, Example: ['Joe Sharp', 'Timbaland']<|endoftext|>
  Country TEXT, Example: ['Netherlands', 'United States']<|endoftext|>
  Song_Name TEXT, Example: ['You', 'Dangerous']<|endoftext|>
  Song_release_year TEXT, Example: ['1992', '2008']<|endoftext|>
  Age INTEGER, Example: [52, 32]<|endoftext|>
  Is_male NUMERIC, Example: ['F', 'T']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (Singer_ID)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE concert (  concert_ID INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  concert_Name TEXT, Example: ['Auditions', 'Super bootcamp']<|endoftext|>
  Theme TEXT, Example: ['Free choice', 'Free choice 2']<|endoftext|>
  Stadium_ID TEXT, Example: ['1', '2']<|endoftext|>
  Year TEXT, Example: ['2014', '2015']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (concert_ID)
  FOREIGN KEY (Stadium_ID) REFERENCES stadium(Stadium_ID)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE singer_in_concert (  concert_ID INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Singer_ID TEXT, Example: ['2', '3']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (concert_ID, Singer_ID)
  FOREIGN KEY (Singer_ID) REFERENCES singer(Singer_ID)
  FOREIGN KEY (concert_ID) REFERENCES concert(concert_ID)
);<|endoftext|>

</schema>
output: SELECT count(*) FROM singer

### Question:
What are the names and ids of all makers with more than 3 models?

### Schema:
<schema>
CREATE TABLE continents (  ContId INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Continent TEXT, Example: ['america', 'europe']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (ContId)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE countries (  CountryId INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  CountryName TEXT, Example: ['usa', 'germany']<|endoftext|>
  Continent INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (CountryId)
  FOREIGN KEY (Continent) REFERENCES continents(ContId)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE car_makers (  Id INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Maker TEXT, Example: ['amc', 'volkswagen']<|endoftext|>
  FullName TEXT, Example: ['American Motor Company', 'Volkswagen']<|endoftext|>
  Country TEXT, Example: ['1', '2']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (Id)
  FOREIGN KEY (Country) REFERENCES countries(CountryId)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE model_list (  ModelId INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Maker INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Model TEXT, Example: ['amc', 'audi']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (ModelId)
  FOREIGN KEY (Maker) REFERENCES car_makers(Id)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE car_names (  MakeId INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  Model TEXT, Example: ['chevrolet', 'buick']<|endoftext|>
  Make TEXT, Example: ['chevrolet chevelle malibu', 'buick skylark 320']<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (MakeId)
  FOREIGN KEY (Model) REFERENCES model_list(Model)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE cars_data (  Id INTEGER, Example: [1, 2]<|endoftext|>
  MPG TEXT, Example: ['18', '15']<|endoftext|>
  Cylinders INTEGER, Example: [8, 4]<|endoftext|>
  Edispl REAL, Example: [307.0, 350.0]<|endoftext|>
  Horsepower TEXT, Example: ['130', '165']<|endoftext|>
  Weight INTEGER, Example: [3504, 3693]<|endoftext|>
  Accelerate REAL, Example: [12.0, 11.5]<|endoftext|>
  Year INTEGER, Example: [1970, 1971]<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (Id)
  FOREIGN KEY (Id) REFERENCES car_names(MakeId)
);<|endoftext|>

</schema>
output: SELECT T1.FullName ,  T1.Id FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >  3;

instruction:

### Question:

### Schema:
<schema>
CREATE TABLE city (  ID INTEGER, Example: [129, 1]<|endoftext|>

  Population INTEGER DEFAULT '0', Example: [1780000, 237500]<|endoftext|>
  PRIMARY KEY (ID)
  FOREIGN KEY (CountryCode) REFERENCES country(Code)
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence (  name NUMERIC, Example: ['city']<|endoftext|>
  seq NUMERIC, Example: [4079]<|endoftext|>
);<|endoftext|>

CREATE TABLE country (  Code TEXT DEFAULT '', Example: ['ABW', 'AFG']<|endoftext|>
  Name TEXT DEFAULT '', Example: ['Aruba', 'Afghanistan']<|endoftext|>
  Continent TEXT DEFAULT 'Asia', Example: ['North America', 'Asia']<|endoftext|>
  Region TEXT DEFAULT '', Example: ['Caribbean', 'Southern and Central Asia']<|endoftext|>
  SurfaceArea REAL DEFAULT '0.00', Example: [193.0, 652090.0]<|endoftext|>
  IndepYear INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, Example: [1919, 1975]<|endoftext|>
  Population INTEGER DEFAULT '0', Example: [103000, 22720000]<|endoftext|>
  LifeExpectancy REAL DEFAULT NULL, Example: [78.4, 45.9]<|endoftext|>
  GNP REAL DEFAULT NULL, Example: [828.0, 5976.0]<|endoftext|>
  GNPOld REAL DEFAULT NULL, Example: [793.0, 7984.0]<|endoftext|>

  HeadOfState TEXT DEFAULT NULL, Example: ['Beatrix', 'Mohammad Omar']<|endoftext|>
  Capital INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, Example: [129, 1]<|endoftext|>
  Code2 TEXT DEFAULT '', Example: ['AW', 'AF']<|endoftext|>

);<|endoftext|>

  IsOfficial TEXT DEFAULT 'F', Example: ['T', 'F']<|endoftext|>

  PRIMARY KEY (CountryCode, Language)

);<|endoftext|>

  zip_code TEXT, Example: ['06646', '43129']<|endoftext|>
  last_name TEXT, Example: ['Braun', 'Ullrich']<|endoftext|>
  email_address TEXT, Example: ['deanna.schuster@example.com', 'lucile.shanahan@example.org']<|endoftext|>

  treatment_type_code TEXT, Example: ['WALK', 'VAC']<|endoftext|>
